action.text: The House Committee on Ethics reported an original measure, H. Rept. 119-756, by Mr. Guest.

calendar.text: Placed on the House Calendar, Calendar No. 87.

action.text: ORDER OF PROCEDURE - Mr. Guest asked unanimous consent that it be in order at any time to consider H. Res. 1498 in the House without intervention of any point of order if called up by the chair of the Committee on Ethics or his designee; that the resolution be considered as read; and that the previous question be considered as ordered on the resolution to adoption without intervening motion or demand for division of the question except for one hour of debate equally divided and controlled by Representative Guest of Mississippi and Representative Edwards of North Carolina, or their respective designees. Agreed to without objection.
Consideration initiated pursuant to a previous order.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with one hour of debate on H. Res. 1498.
The previous question was ordered pursuant to a previous order of the House.

POSTPONED PROCEEDINGS - At the conclusion of debate on H.Res. 1498, the Chair put the question on agreeing to the resolution and by voice vote, announced the ayes had prevailed. Mr. Edwards demanded the yeas and nays and the Chair postponed further proceedings until a time to be announced.

vote.text: On agreeing to the resolution Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: 413 - 2 (Roll no. 292).

action.text: Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
